contentItem.title: 等量关系：棱锥与比例
contentItem.englishTitle: In equal pyramids which have triangular bases the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights; and those pyramids in which the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights are equal.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: In equal pyramids which have triangular bases the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights; and those pyramids in which the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights are equal.
在具有三角底边的等式金字塔中,底边是对等成比例对等的高度;而底边对等成比例对等的金字塔是等式的。

For let there be equal pyramids which have the triangular bases ABC, DEF and vertices the points G, H; I say that in the pyramids ABCG, DEFH the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights, that is, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so is the height of the pyramid DEFH to the height of the pyramid ABCG.
等同的金字塔,三角形底边 ABC,DEF,顶端G,H;我说,在金字塔ABCG,DEFH,底边对等成比例对高,即底边 ABC对底边对高比等于金字塔DEFH对高比
For let the parallelepipedal solids BGML, EHQP be completed.
完成平行管道固体BGML,EHQP

Now, since the pyramid ABCG is equal to the pyramid DEFH, and the solid BGML is six times the pyramid ABCG, and the solid EHQP six times the pyramid DEFH, therefore the solid BGML is equal to the solid EHQP.
现在,金字塔ABCG等于金字塔DEFH, 固体BGML是金字塔ABCG的六倍, 固体EHQP是金字塔DEFH的六倍, 所以,固体BGML等于EHQP。

But in equal parallelepipedal solids the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights; [[XI. 34](/principles/euclid-11-34)] therefore, as the base BM is to the base EQ, so is the height of the solid EHQP to the height of the solid BGML.
但是,在平行管道固体中,底边是对等的成比例乘以高度;因此,底边 BM乘以底边 EQ等于EHQP乘以BGML乘以固体高度 [[XI. 34](/principles/euclid-11-34)]
But, as the base BM is to EQ, so is the triangle ABC to the triangle DEF. [[I. 34](/principles/euclid-1-34)]
但是,底边 BM对EQ的比等于三角ABC对三角DEF的比；BM 与 EQ 之比等于 ABC 与 DEF 之比。 [[I. 34](/principles/euclid-1-34)]
Therefore also, as the triangle ABC is to the triangle DEF, so is the height of the solid EHQP to the height of the solid BGML. [[V. 11](/principles/euclid-5-11)]
因此,三角形ABC对三角形DEF的比也等于固体EHQP对固体BGML的高度比 [[V. 11](/principles/euclid-5-11)]

But the height of the solid EHQP is the same with the height of the pyramid DEFH, and the height of the solid BGML is the same with the height of the pyramid ABCG, therefore, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so is the height of the pyramid DEFH to the height of the pyramid ABCG.
但EHQP固体的高度与DEFH金字塔的高度相同,BGML固体的高度与ABCG金字塔的高度相同,因此,底边 ABC与底边 DEF之比等于DEFH金字塔的高度与ABCG金字塔的高度之比
Therefore in the pyramids ABCG, DEFH the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights.
因此,在金字塔ABCG,DEFH中,底边是成比例对高。

Next, in the pyramids ABCG, DEFH let the bases be reciprocally proportional to the heights; that is, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so let the height of the pyramid DEFH be to the height of the pyramid ABCG; I say that the pyramid ABCG is equal to the pyramid DEFH.
其次,在金字塔ABCG,DEFH,底边乘以成比例乘以成比例乘以高度;也就是说,底边,ABC乘以底边,DEF,因此,金字塔DEFH的高度应乘以金字塔ABCG的高度;我说,金字塔ABCG等于金字塔DEFH。

For, with the same construction, since, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so is the height of the pyramid DEFH to the height of the pyramid ABCG, while, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so is the parallelogram BM to the parallelogram EQ, therefore also, as the parallelogram BM is to the parallelogram EQ, so is the height of the pyramid DEFH to the height of the pyramid ABCG. [[V. 11](/principles/euclid-5-11)]
同样的构造,底边 ABC对底边 DEF的比等于金字塔DEFH对金字塔ABCG的高度之比,而底边 ABC对底边 DEF的比等于平行四边形 BM对平行四边形 EQ的比,因此,平行四边形 BM对平行四边形 EQ的比等于金字塔DEFH对金字塔DEFH对ABCG的高度之比；ABC 与 DEF 之比等于 BM 与 EQ 之比 [[V. 11](/principles/euclid-5-11)]

But the height of the pyramid DEFH is the same with the height of the parallelepiped EHQP, and the height of the pyramid ABCG is the same with the height of the parallelepiped BGML; therefore, as the base BM is to the base EQ, so is the height of the parallelepiped EHQP to the height of the parallelepiped BGML.
但是,金字塔DEFH的高度与平行管道EHQP的高度相同,而金字塔ABCG的高度与平行管道BGML的高度相同;因此,底边 BM与底边 EQ的比等于平行管道EHQP与平行管道BGML的高度之比

But those parallelepipedal solids in which the bases are reciprocally proportional to the heights are equal; [[XI. 34](/principles/euclid-11-34)] therefore the parallelepipedal solid BGML is equal to the parallelepipedal solid EHQP.
但是,底边水管的平行固体,即成比例至高度的对等固体,是相等的;因此,平行水管的固体BGML水管的固体,相当于平行水管的固体EHQP。 [[XI. 34](/principles/euclid-11-34)]
And the pyramid ABCG is a sixth part of BGML, and the pyramid DEFH a sixth part of the parallelepiped EHQP; therefore the pyramid ABCG is equal to the pyramid DEFH.
金字塔ABCG是BGML的第六部分,金字塔DEFH是EHQP平行管道的第六部分,因此金字塔ABCG等于金字塔DEFH。
Therefore etc Q. E. D.
因此,等等Q E. D。
